cause: The workflow supplied `"reservation_id": "order-17"` to shipping instead of the reservation identifier produced by inventory. The inventory source defines reserve to return `reservation_id` as `reservation:` followed by the order ID, i.e. `reservation:order-17`; the generated shipping program therefore used the wrong identifier and could not produce the required downstream value.
evidence: The execution error records kind `workflow_failed` with reason `explicit_failure`.
The inventory prelude source computes `reservation_id` as `(str "reservation:" (get request "order_id"))`, producing `reservation:order-17`.
The shipping prelude source preserves the supplied `reservation_id` in its result, so it cannot correct the incorrect `order-17` input.
